claimChanges.claimText: Wooflash is listed for Université catholique de Louvain (UCLouvain) in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.
Copilot Chat is listed for Université catholique de Louvain (UCLouvain) in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

Piccolo (BETA) is listed for Université catholique de Louvain (UCLouvain) in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.
UCLouvain maintains a public official AI documents page that centralizes the main institutional documents on use of artificial intelligence at the university.
UCLouvain's student guidance frames generative AI use in academic work around responsibility, authenticity, and transparency, while telling students to check course-specific rules before using AI.
UCLouvain's student AI page recommends Piccolo BETA, Wooflash, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Word Online transcription as available AI-related tools for students and says they respect data protection.
UCLouvain describes Piccolo as a free generative-AI interface for staff and students and says it does not train models or monitor conversations based on users' conversations.

UCLouvain's 2024 working-group note recommends that teachers be explicit about whether generative AI is allowed or prohibited in learning activities and advises against using AI detectors to determine precisely whether a text was generated by AI.

Piccolo (BETA) is listed for Université catholique de Louvain (UCLouvain) in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.
UCLouvain maintains a public official AI documents page that centralizes the main institutional documents on use of artificial intelligence at the university.
UCLouvain's student guidance frames generative AI use in academic work around responsibility, authenticity, and transparency, while telling students to check course-specific rules before using AI.
UCLouvain's student AI page recommends Piccolo BETA, Wooflash, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Word Online transcription as available AI-related tools for students and says they respect data protection.
UCLouvain describes Piccolo as a free generative-AI interface for staff and students and says it does not train models or monitor conversations based on users' conversations.

UCLouvain's 2024 working-group note recommends that teachers be explicit about whether generative AI is allowed or prohibited in learning activities and advises against using AI detectors to determine precisely whether a text was generated by AI.
